content: Letter 4, to Amīr Jalāl al-Dīn (ca. 816/1413, Isfahan?), 'almost certainly' Amīr Jalāl al-Dīn Fīrūzshāh per MK: Ibn Turka tells the amir that harassment (tashvīsh) by envious individuals obliges him to leave the region for a time (i.e., move to Shiraz), and recommends as his replacement the young but learned Mawlānā Sharaf al-Dīn Yaʿqūb (TMN/MS pp. 2-3). MK's footnote places this before Ibn Turka took the qadiship of Yazd in ca. 825/1422 after his first trial in Herat.
